description: BAe 146-300, c/n E3146, ex-Mahan Air, in use as a restaurant at Malekabad near Mahan in Kerman province. Mapped in OpenStreetMap as the Kavir-e Mahan aircraft and visible as an intact white jet airliner beside a walled compound on Esri imagery. The database entry was updated by the site administrator in February 2026, the most recent first-hand record in this dataset.
